title: When the Alibi Burns Again
author: Sable Reyes
blurb: Ines Joubert, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
